messages:
sam: Morning — quick release check. Cut window opens 14:00 UTC. Train looks healthy but patch queue has a little merge-tilt (rebases needed). I have 3 cherries: two tiny docs/fix PRs and one model pin (needs confirm).
jordan: Going to grab the model-pin PR. I’ll do the rebase and smoke it locally. ETA 30m. @tina can you sanity-check perf after pin?
tina: Yep, will run quick perf checks on canary once jordan pushes. Heads-up: GPU pool A is down to 70% free slots (burstable only). If the perf checks spike we might need to shift to pool B.
leo: I’m on the merge queue — will prioritize the docs fixes and the hotfix labeled rail:hotfix. Anyone want me to hold off merging until the model pin is in?
jor dan: (typo) I mean jordan: model-pin PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2345 — includes quantized weights switch. I left notes about expected latency bump ~+5%.
sam: Good catch. If latency +5% holds on canary we should still be okay for this rollout. If we see +10% then fallback policy should kick to the previous variant. Tina, add a perf alert for >=8% on canary run?
tina: Will add alert: severity=warning threshold=8% (canary-3). Also adding a short eval prompt set for smoke checks.
leo: Merging docs PRs now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2401 and https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2402 — green CI.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued for train-105 at 14:05 UTC. Canary-3 will get model-pin if PR #2345 is merged before 13:45 UTC.
jordan: Rebased and pushed #2345. CI passed. Ran quick local smoke — looks okay. Tina, you can trigger canary when ready.
tina: Triggering canary now. Will post results in 10–12m.
sam: Thanks. Blockers: none from my side besides watching the GPU slot / perf. If GPU pressure gets worse, leo — can you file a quick ticket to request pool B burst or schedule a swap?
leo: Will open ticket in infra backlog and ping infra slack channel. Ticket: INFRA-987.
tina: Canary smoke done: latency +4.7% p50, token throughput within SLO. No memory issues. Marking canary healthy. :thumbsup:
sam: Nice. OK to merge model-pin into release after canary — @jordan feel free to merge and tag for cut.
jordan: Merged and tagged. Cut-ready.
sam: Sweet. Closing this standup. If anything pops, drop it here or ping me directly. :rocket:
